Name: Wild Egg Forage Retexture
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
I really love the mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20222]Foraging Wild Eggs[/url], and I wanted to make the sprites look closer to the vanilla eggs and mayo/pickles.

There are four options:

[u][b]Content Patcher Version 1[/b][/u]﻿: This one sticks closer to the original style of the mod and keeps them both in jars, and uses content patcher to overwrite the mod.
[b][u]Replacer Image Version 1[/u][/b]: Th﻿is is the same as the above, but it directly overwrites the image of the mod file. A bit less convenient because you'll have to download/overwrite every time the mod updates, but it does prevent things from being loaded twice.
[b][u]Content Patcher Version 2[/u][/b]: The sprites are more Stardew adjacent, and mimic the pickle and mayo jar textures.
[b][u]Replacer Image Version 2[/u][/b]: The same as the above, just like replacer version 1 it directly overwrites the image in the mod file.

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
